title: My first button
summary: A button that says hello when you tap it. Your very first app!
done: You built your first app: a button that answers when you tap it. That is how every app starts!

welcome.text: Hi! I am here to help. Together, we are going to build your first app: a **button** that says hello. Ready?

add-button.text: Drag a **Button** from the palette onto the phone screen.
add-button.hint: You can also select it and press Enter.

button-text.text: Your button is here! In the **text** box, on the right, write what it shows, for example “Say hello”.

add-text.text: Now add a **Text**: this is where your app will answer.
add-text.hint: Drag it below the button, or select it and press Enter.

go-blocks.text: The screen is ready. To bring it to life, open the **Blocks** tab.

event-block.text: Click **{{Button}}** in the list on the left, then drag the [when {{Button}} is clicked] block to the middle.
event-block.hint: “When…” blocks wait for something to happen.

set-block.text: Click **{{Text}}**, then drag the [set text of {{Text}} to] block **inside** the “when {{Button}} is clicked” block.
set-block.hint: Bring it close to the notch: it snaps in by itself.

type-hello.text: Click the white box of the “set” block and type what your app should say, for example “Hello!”.

try-it.text: Your app is already running in the preview, on the right. Tap your button and see what happens!
